title: From Josh Howlin to Barker Playfield: NFL-inspired pups headline Puppy Bowl XXII

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: From Josh Howlin to Barker Playfield: NFL-inspired pups headline Puppy Bowl XXII
sources.description: Before the Seahawks and Patriots clash in Super Bowl LX, Barker Playfield, Josh Howlin and more take the field for Puppy Bowl XXII, competing for the Lombarky Trophy and the title of "Most Pupular."
